item.title: A Full List of Current 2026 K-Pop Concerts (Updating)
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the provided article:
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our K-pop concert update! If you're a fan of K-pop, you're in luck because 2026 is shaping up to be an amazing year for concerts and world tours. With so many big names on the road, it can be tough to keep track of who's touring where. But don't worry, we've got you covered."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Some of the biggest names in K-pop are embarking on massive world tours and even Las Vegas residencies. Artists like BLACKPINK's Lisa, BTS, ENHYPEN, IVE, aespa, and KATSEYE are just a few of the many acts headed out on tour. And it's not just tours - many K-pop groups are also headlining music festivals and conventions around the world."
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, what's happening in August 2026? KCon LA is coming up on August 14th to 16th, featuring headliners like NCT 127, ZEROBASEONE, and TOMORROW X TOGETHER. You can catch BTS on their Arirang world tour in Arlington, Texas, on August 15th and 16th. And if you're a fan of MAMAMOO, they're on their 2026 4Ward reunion tour, with stops in Chicago, Fort Worth, Cedar Park, Los Angeles, and San Jose throughout the month."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Want to get tickets to these shows? You can find them on Ticketmaster, as well as resale and third-party sites like StubHub and SeatGeek. We'll be keeping you updated on all the latest K-pop concerts and tours, so be sure to check back with us for more information."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our K-pop concert update. We'll see you at the next show!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
